lines.text: Rebuilt street by street, from the real map of Dhaka.
Take the wheel, under the pillars of Metro Line Six.
Or leave the car behind. Climb to the platform, and ride the metro.
Walk the footpaths. Find the stadium, the bazaars, the places you know.
No download. No install. It runs right in your browser.
Mirpur Drive. Play it free, right now.
